messages:
Alyssa (CSM): quick follow-up on Meridian Health — they've hit three latency spikes this week, two repeat 502s during the nightly sync. filing for our weekly health check. ticket MH-4921. any obvious owners?
Mike (Support Lead): noted. pulled the incident timeline — spikes at 08:14 and 11:03 UTC. looks like batch-job overlap + cache churn. assigning Jordan to reproduce and propose mitigation. @Jordan can you own reproduction?
Jordan (SE): I can take it. can someone drop request traces and a minimal error sample here?
Mike (Support Lead): pasting an error snippet from the pod logs:
```
2026-03-18T08:14:21Z ERROR request_id=abc123 upstream_timeout status=502 attempt=1
```
Traces: https://redwood.example.com/traces/MH-4921
Jordan (SE): I ran a load repro and saw repeated KV cache evictions after the recent model swap. reproduces locally when cache TTL is low + concurrent syncs. probable short-term fix: extend TTL and pin model variant during peak windows.
Alyssa (CSM): we need clear action items + owners, and an update for Meridian before next renewal check-in. renewal risk currently medium given repeat incidents.
Jordan (SE): Action: extend cache TTL + pin model variant to v2.3 for peak hours. Owner: Jordan. ETA: today EOD. I'll open a PR and start a canary.
Tony (Oncall SRE): Action: add temporary routing rule to divert traffic to warm instances during sync windows. Owner: Tony. ETA: 2h. I'll also add a synthetic check to catch early cache-thrashing.
Mike (Support Lead): Action: update MH-4921 with mitigation steps and a customer comms draft. Owner: Mike. ETA: tomorrow AM.
Alyssa (CSM): thanks — please cc customer-updates in the ticket comments. I'll mark the account health board and note the renewal watch.
Jordan (SE): PR: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/834
Staging config snippet I pushed:
```
cache.ttl=7200
model.variant=redwood/v2.3
```
Canaries are running now.
Tony (Oncall SRE): canary is stable for 30m under synthetic load. I'll promote after another hour if stable.
incidents-bot: MH-4921 status changed: mitigation_in_progress -> monitoring (owner: Jordan)
Mike (Support Lead): I'll schedule a quick sync with Meridian ops at 14:00 UTC to walk through telemetry and the comms draft.
Alyssa (CSM): perfect. I'll update the weekly account-health doc and flag renewal team. :white_check_mark:
Jordan (SE): will follow up in the ticket with post-mitigation metrics and a short runbook step for future model swaps.
Tony (Oncall SRE): added a temporary alert: cache_eviction_rate > 0.05 for 5m -> page oncall. temporary until we increase TTL.
Alyssa (CSM): great. thanks everyone — please add any outstanding notes to MH-4921 so I can include in the exec summary.
